content.title: Brazil's Gol Airlines secures new financing to support Chapter 11 exit
content.summary: Brazilian airline Gol on Thursday announced that it has struck a new deal with key creditors, paving the way for the company to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection likely by the end of June.  With the new development, Gol has now secured at least $1.375 billion in financing to exit bankruptcy, the filing showed.  Gol said that support from this majority group of creditors will substantially increase the chances of its restructuring plan being approved.

thumbnail.caption: Gol aircraft is seen at Brasilia International Airport

content.title: GOL Linhas Aéreas Secures Tax Settlement Amid Financial Restructuring
content.summary: GOL Linhas Aereas Inteligentes SA ( (GOLLQ) ) has issued an update. GOL Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes has entered a significant tax settlement agreement with Brazilian tax authorities to manage its liabilities, estimated at R$ 5.5 billion.
